name: ANSI/IEEE liquid flow switch symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for liquid flow switch, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The flow-switch form associates an electrical contact with a documented flow condition. A cooling-system permissive or loss-of-flow alarm needs the process circuit and operate condition to be identified, rather than a bare contact label.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: State whether the contact indicates adequate flow or another specified condition.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A flow switch reports a discrete condition while a flow transmitter reports a measured quantity.
